reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Unfunded guarantee of up to €25 million provided by the Bank in favour of Crnogorska Komercijalna Banka ("CKB"). The guarantee will cover up to 50 per cent of the credit risk on a pro rata basis on the newly generated micro, small and medium-sized entreprise ("MSME") loan portfolio of up to €50 million originated by CKB. PRS is issued in two equal tranches and the 2nd tranche is uncommitted. This project is the first pilot implementation of the Portfolio Risk Sharing product by the EBRD in Montenegro. The product aims to release a bank's risk-taking capacity to boost on-lending to MSMEs, addressing an MSME financing gap in the market.
